name: LNG regasification (open rack, submerged combustion, ambient air vaporisers)
principle: Cryogenic LNG is pumped to pipeline pressure and warmed to gas in vaporisers. Open rack vaporisers use seawater flowing over aluminium panels; submerged combustion vaporisers burn send-out gas to heat a water bath; ambient air vaporisers use finned tubes and air. Floating storage and regasification units do the same on a vessel.
